meta.description: Make Bold Spark ecosystem inventory of initiatives, reference implementations, tools, and demonstrations
meta.positioning: Make Bold Spark explores practical ways to improve software delivery through better context, specifications, and AI-assisted development.
meta.tagline: Spec-Driven Systems. Real Applications. Practical AI.
meta.supportingPhrase: Better Context. Better Software. Faster Delivery.
meta.inventoryPurpose: Show how each Spark initiative supports practical specification-driven and AI-assisted software delivery.
meta.inventorySource: Generated from active Make Bold Spark subdomain metadata maintained in this file.
meta.ecosystemIntroduction: Each Spark initiative explores a different aspect of building better software through better context, specifications, workflows, contracts, and AI-assisted development. Together they form a practical collection of reference implementations demonstrating real-world software delivery patterns.

categories.name: Flagship Initiatives
categories.description: Primary Make Bold Spark initiatives that define the platform vision and most directly express the ecosystem message.
categories.messageRole: Establishes Make Bold Spark as the organizing vision for specification-driven, agent-ready software delivery.

categories.name: Context and AI
categories.description: Tools and patterns for prompt context, conversation context, and AI-assisted workflows.
categories.messageRole: Explores how better context improves human and AI collaboration.

categories.name: GitHub and Git Utilities

categories.messageRole: Turns Git and GitHub activity into delivery context, repository insight, and reporting artifacts.

categories.name: API Context and Integration

categories.messageRole: Turns API behavior into implementation-ready context.

categories.name: Application Frameworks
categories.description: Reusable web, UI, publishing, component, and application delivery patterns.
categories.messageRole: Demonstrates implementation patterns that accelerate application delivery.

categories.messageRole: Shows the broader surface area of practical software delivery exploration.

relationshipDiagram.note: Make Bold Spark serves as the public-facing innovation ecosystem of Make Bold Solutions LLC. Each initiative explores practical ways to improve software delivery through better context, specifications, workflows, contracts, Git/GitHub reporting, and AI-assisted development.

subsites.name: DevSpark
subsites.description: Flagship specification-driven development initiative that helps transform requirements into specifications, plans, tasks, and implementation context.
subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Defines the core Make Bold Spark workflow for moving from business intent to implementation-ready context.
subsites.contextContribution: Transforms requirements into specifications, plans, tasks, and coding-agent guidance.
subsites.deliveryPattern: Requirements -> Specifications -> Plans -> Tasks -> Implementation

subsites.name: API Test Spark
subsites.description: From API contracts to feature stories: OpenAPI-powered exploration with real request and response examples for agent-ready implementation context.
subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Explains how APIs are consumed by converting contracts and live behavior into better implementation context.
subsites.contextContribution: Combines OpenAPI metadata, remote API exploration, real responses, and workflow examples.
subsites.deliveryPattern: OpenAPI Contracts -> Feature Stories -> Client Implementation
subsites.tagline: From API Contracts to Feature Stories

subsites.name: Chat
subsites.description: Real-time chat and AI-powered conversation interfaces built on SignalR.
subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Demonstrates conversation-oriented interfaces that can become reusable context.
subsites.contextContribution: Shows how real-time conversations and AI interactions can be captured as structured software delivery inputs.
subsites.deliveryPattern: Conversations -> Interaction Context -> Guided Follow-up

subsites.name: Git Spark
subsites.description: npm package and reporting utility for analyzing any Git repository and generating interactive reports with contributor statistics, commit history, code change patterns, and file analysis.
subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Provides repository-agnostic Git reporting that turns commit history into delivery insight and review context.
subsites.contextContribution: Analyzes local or accessible Git repositories to summarize commits, contributors, change patterns, and files without depending on GitHub-specific ownership data.
subsites.deliveryPattern: Any Git Repository -> Commit Analysis -> Interactive Delivery Report
subsites.tagline: Git Repository Reporting for Any Repo

subsites.name: Simple Blog
subsites.description: Mark's Dev Notebook — a simple developer blog on GitHub Pages with Jekyll covering Azure, .NET, and software delivery topics.
subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Publishes practical delivery insights that support the broader Make Bold Spark message.
subsites.contextContribution: Captures reusable technical notes, examples, and decision context.
subsites.deliveryPattern: Experience -> Insight -> Reusable Guidance

subsites.name: HttpClient Decorator
subsites.description: Resilience patterns for .NET HTTP clients — retry, circuit breaker, caching, and logging decorators.
subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Demonstrates practical API client resilience patterns.
subsites.contextContribution: Shows implementation examples for reliable outbound HTTP behavior.
subsites.deliveryPattern: Integration Need -> Resilience Pattern -> Client Implementation

subsites.name: HttpClient Utility
subsites.description: Drop-in HttpClient wrapper for .NET 8-10 with Polly resilience, response caching, OpenTelemetry tracing, and batch execution orchestration.
subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Packages proven API client patterns into a reusable implementation accelerator.
subsites.contextContribution: Provides concrete client behavior that can be reused instead of re-specified from scratch.
subsites.deliveryPattern: Client Requirements -> Reusable Utility -> Consistent Integration

subsites.name: Slurper Spark
subsites.description: WebSpark.Slurper NuGet package site — a .NET data extractor for XML, JSON, CSV, and HTML using dynamic objects.
subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Turns varied data formats into consumable implementation context.
subsites.contextContribution: Extracts useful structure from XML, JSON, CSV, and HTML without requiring custom models first.
subsites.deliveryPattern: Raw Data -> Structured Extraction -> Application Context

subsites.name: Slurper Demo
subsites.description: Interactive demo for the WebSpark.Slurper data extraction library covering XML, JSON, CSV, and HTML parsing.
subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Makes data extraction behavior inspectable through a working demonstration system.
subsites.contextContribution: Provides examples that explain how raw data becomes usable application input.
subsites.deliveryPattern: Sample Data -> Extraction Demo -> Implementation Example

subsites.name: Bootstrap Showcase

subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Demonstrates Bootstrap-based UI patterns that can accelerate application delivery.

subsites.deliveryPattern: UI Pattern -> Component Example -> Application Screen

subsites.name: Bootswatch Themes

subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Helps evaluate visual system choices through working component previews.
subsites.contextContribution: Provides comparative UI examples that reduce ambiguity in design implementation.
subsites.deliveryPattern: Theme Option -> Component Preview -> UI Decision

subsites.name: Tailwind Showcase
subsites.description: Design system showcase and component gallery built with Tailwind CSS.
subsites.makeBoldSparkRole: Demonstrates Tailwind-based implementation patterns for reusable application UI.

subsites.name: UI Components
